lifecycles._note: Secret Vault CRUD covering the 2 uncovered WRITE ops: POST /v1/secretvault (create vault) and PUT /v1/secretvault/{secret_vault_id}/terminated (schedule deletion). Bodies from data/api_docs.json (secretvaultcreaterequest / secretvaultterminatedrequest). Field rules from the doc schema: name MUST match ^[a-z0-9]*$ len 3-63; temporary_key_ttl_nhours in [1,36]; vault_token_ttl_ndays in [30,7300]; acl_cidr is a comma-separated CIDR string; access_key_id is a REQUIRED real Access Key ID (the SCP_ACCESS_KEY of the caller) — injected SAFELY via {env:SCP_ACCESS_KEY} (never committed; resolved at runtime from the runner env, same mechanism as cloud-ml SCR credentials). Create captures $.secret_vault.id (response envelope secretvaultcreateresponse.secret_vault.id). If create succeeds, the lifecycle reads it (get-secretvault + get-temporarykey) then schedules termination via PUT .../terminated (waiting_time_ndays=7, in [7,30]); the cleanup also issues the terminate (the only teardown verb — there is no hard DELETE on secretvault). The terminate step is optional+grouped so when create did not yield an id it still fires against a {placeholder} id, recording the PUT .../terminated write and 4xx-ing. All steps optional so a missing/foreign access key isolates as a warning, not a run failure. Chain: list-secretvaults(GET,capture_soft) -> create(POST,capture) -> get-secretvault(GET) -> get-temporarykey(GET) -> probe-reads -> terminate(PUT destructive).

steps.name: list-secretvaults
steps._note: List all secret vaults (GET /v1/secretvault, listsecretvault). Real envelope: {count, page, secret_vaults[], size, sort}. capture_soft grabs the first vault id so the probe-reads step can exercise showsecretvault (GET /v1/secretvault/{id}) against a real id when vaults exist. When count=0 (empty account), capture_soft yields None/placeholder and the show probe 404s (SOFT). Live-verified 200 2026-06-20.

steps.name: get-secretvault
steps._note: id-bound read (show secret vault). Closes the secret_vault_id getid GET /v1/secretvault/{secret_vault_id}. Keys off the create-captured secret_vault_id; tolerant [200,400,403,404] because create needs a real access_key_id (credential precondition) and 4xx's in a LIGHT run, leaving the id a placeholder (normalizes to catalog '*'). Makes the endpoint statically reachable in a LIGHT run (complements probe-reads).

steps.name: get-temporarykey
steps._note: id-bound read (issue/show temporary key for the vault). Closes the secret_vault_id getid GET /v1/temporarykey/{secret_vault_id}. Same tolerant rationale as get-secretvault. NOTE: a real 2xx needs a live vault + iam-temp-auth-key console credential (env-skip precondition); statically this step makes the endpoint reachable in a LIGHT run regardless.
